purpose: Source-to-English semantic parity audit. Original Chinese snippets exist ONLY as non-runtime test anchors; these are not machine-translation proof.
translation_principles: Preserve MUST/SHOULD/MAY modality, triggers, exemptions and prohibitions.
Do not silently omit examples that encode a unique exception or an accessibility/state boundary.
Keep file paths, code identifiers, framework version conditions and verification status meanings intact.
Translate runtime prose; keep language-specific product text only when it tests localization.
No document counts as independently semantically verified merely because static checks pass.
